title: Render through a fresh demonstrably owned Hancom instance
when: A native render or scratch behavior check is needed.
do: Use an input copy and hash.
Resolve fresh COM WindowHandle to PID absent from the preexisting process baseline.
Open/export/Quit only that verified owned instance.
avoid: No GetActiveObject attachment, registry/security-module changes or unrelated process termination.
check: Actual native version, page count, control scope and owned-instance exit recorded.
limitation: Historical version 13.0.0.3457 is not proof of the current runtime.
